title: skills/ticks docs still document the deleted tk herd commands
description: Filed from a worker finding on tick nkf attempt 3. The skill references still describe tk herd spawn/wait/collect/reconcile/cleanup/notify/paint/watch/plugin, which no longer exist. A reader following them gets an unknown-command error. Point them at ticfac run-epic instead, and keep whatever is still true about the substrate.
acceptance_criteria: No skill reference documents a deleted tk herd command; what replaced them is stated; the herdr-runner and agent-runner references agree with the commands that now exist.
